notes: dev.nebius.com is a small builder-marketing microsite, NOT a full developer portal. It hosts exactly 4 first-party pages: / (home: 'Nebius for AI Builders'), /ai-cloud, /token-factory, /serverless. All three product pages are content hubs that aggregate links (quickstarts, docs, YouTube playlists, blog deep-dives, GitHub cookbooks, Discord) and embed a newsletter signup form; they do not host docs or app functionality themselves. The sitemap at https://dev.nebius.com/sitemap.xml is a sitemapindex that only delegates to https://nebius.com/server-sitemap.xml and https://docs.nebius.com/sitemap.xml (it does not enumerate dev.nebius.com's own pages). Tavily's map of dev.nebius.com pulled in ~180 URLs, but the vast majority are cross-domain ecosystem pages (nebius.com, docs.nebius.com, academy.nebius.com, tokenfactory.nebius.com, console.nebius.com, status.nebius.com) reached via outbound links, plus a handful of crawler artifacts like https://dev.nebius.com/nebius.com/ai-cloud which return 404 (confirmed) — these are bad relative-link resolutions, not real pages. The logo links to https://nebius.com/ (Home), reinforcing that dev.nebius.com is positioned as a satellite of the main site. No on-site community/builders program, events map, content library, leaderboard, integrations directory, office-hours booking, team page, pricing, or about page exists on dev.nebius.com; where those concepts exist at all, they live on other subdomains (community is just a Discord invite; events live at nebius.com/events). page_count reflects only the 4 first-party dev.nebius.com pages.
method: Tavily tavily_map (depth 2) + tavily_extract on the product pages + WebFetch of homepage and /sitemap.xml. 404 of dev.nebius.com/nebius.com/ai-cloud confirmed via tavily_extract failed_results.
